title: Invoice export query uses the shared filter builder
description:
Refactor the invoice export query path so it reuses the shared billing filter builder and keeps export results aligned with the billing workspace filters.

## Means of Compliance
| # | Acceptance Criterion | MoC | Evidence |
|---|----------------------|-----|----------|
| 1 | CSV export applies the same filters as the billing workspace list. | integ | tests/billing/test_invoice_export_filters.py |

acceptance_criteria:
